rows.en:
All right! Starting right now, I'm gonna
practice some party trick for next year...!
rows.notes: Hoshimura, both versions. Ippatsugei = a one-shot party trick.

rows.en:
Yeah! I'm gonna give it everything I've got!!
I'd better head home and start practicing...
See ya, \p!
Yeah, see you next year, Hoshimura.

(She's already thinking about next Christmas...
That's so Hoshimura...)

(Yeah, I'm glad I got to have
a fun Christmas this year too.)
rows.notes: Male Yui and male Pinon versions.

rows.en:
(I promised to go to this year's Christmas party
with Yui, but...)

Of course it's okay!
I promised because I wanted to spend it
with you, Yui.
rows.notes: Answers Yui asking if it is really okay to spend Christmas with her.

rows.en: Ah, wait up, Yui!
It really was a great Christmas.
rows.notes: Female Yui and female Michel versions.

rows.en: See you next year, Yui.

(She's already thinking about next Christmas...
That's so Yui...)

(Yeah, I'm glad I got to have
a fun Christmas this year too.)
rows.notes: Female Yui and female Pinon versions.

rows.en:
(I'm supposed to meet Yamashiro-sensei
at the school gate, but...)

\p.
Merry Christmas.
Merry Christmas, Yamashiro-sensei.

Don't get too carried away.
As a teacher, there are some things
I can't overlook.
That was so much fun again this year, wasn't it~
rows.notes: Shared: Yamashiro (both genders) and female Claire versions; polite form.

rows.en:
I never imagined Gary would cross-dress...
What a thing to be made to witness
at the end of the year.
rows.notes: Yamashiro calls Gary by bare name, kept bare.

rows.en: Ahaha... It was quite a Christmas.

I agree.
But next year, shall we have a Christmas
party, just the two of us?

...I'm joking.
Well then, see you next year.
Yes, see you next year.

(I'm glad I got to have a fun Christmas, but...
that last remark from Yamashiro-sensei
surprised me a little.)

(I'm glad I got to have a fun Christmas, but...
that last remark from Yamashiro-sensei
surprised me a little.)
rows.notes: Female version; same English as c22608.

rows.en:
(I'm going to the Academy Christmas party
with Akimizu, but she's late...)

\p-kun!
I'm sorry I'm late...

Oh, Akimizu.
It's fine, I haven't been waiting that long.

I couldn't decide what to bring
for the gift exchange...

Ah, that's a tough one~
So, what did you end up getting?

Um...
Don't laugh, okay...?
I won't. So, what is it?

Well, um...
A "Super Deculture Lottery" ticket...
rows.notes: Super Dekaruchaa takarakuji: in-game lottery, 'Deculture' per glossary lore term. Not a glossary name.

rows.en:
See, since nobody knows who'll end up with it,
I figured anyone would be happy to get it...
rows.notes: Pun on ataru (to win / to be drawn in the exchange); English keeps the exchange sense.

rows.en: I-I see...
A-anyway, come on, let's hurry and go!
Oh, yeah, let's!
That Christmas party was fun, huh?
It was! And my present made someone happy, too!

I can't believe Luis-san got it...
I don't think he's even part of the Academy
in the first place...
Well, it's Christmas, so who cares!

Well, I'd better head home now.
Here's to next year too, \p-kun!
rows.notes: Yoroshiku: 'Here's to next year'; the player answers 'Yeah, same here!' (c22627).

rows.en: Yeah, same here!
rows.notes: x5: Akimizu and Alto Christmas (both genders) and Akimizu White Day ('korekara mo yoroshiku'). Neutral.

rows.en:
(Still, that present of Akimizu's...
She's more practical than she looks...)

(I'm going to the Academy Christmas party
with Yuu, but...)

\p-chan!
I'm sorry I'm late...

Oh, Yuu.
It's fine, I haven't been waiting that long.
I won't. So, what is it?
Yeah, let's go!

I can't believe Luis-san got it...
He isn't even part of the Academy,
is he...?

Well, I'm heading home now.
Here's to next year too, \p-chan!

(Still, that present of Yuu's...
She's more practical than she looks...)

(I'm supposed to meet Claire-senpai
at the school gate, but...)
Merry Christmas, Claire-senpai.

Hmm, I think I'd rather spend it
just the two of us...
rows.notes: Claire, both versions; answers the player's 'let's all liven it up more than last year'.

rows.en: Oh, never mind. Shall we go?

I never dreamed Yuu would show up
in an outfit like that!
It really turned out to be a great Christmas.
I think so too...

But next year, why don't we make it a Christmas
party for just the two of us?

...Just kidding!
Well then, see you next year.
Okay. Have a happy New Year!

(I'm glad I got to have a fun Christmas, but...
that last remark from Claire-senpai
surprised me a little~)
Merry Christmas, Claire-senpai!

(I promised to go to this year's Christmas party
with Pinon-chan, but...)

M-merry Christmas...
\p.

Merry Christmas!
Let's all have even more fun than last year!

Wait, what's wrong, Pinon-chan?
You seem kind of nervous.

I-I'm not nervous or anything!
I'm NOT, got it?!
You're obviously stiff as a board, Pinon-chan...

I-I am not!
Hurry up, we're going to the party!
Wait up, Pinon-chan!

Who knew Yui would get that carried away?
It really caught me off guard.
Y-yeah, it was...
rows.notes: Answers the player's 'It really was a great Christmas' (c22584).

rows.en:
Hey, \p...
Will you spend it with me like this
next year too...?
Huh? Yeah, of course, Pinon-chan.

R-really?!
That's a promise! A promise, you hear?!
S-see you, \p!
See you next year, Pinon-chan.

(Making promises for next year already...
Pinon-chan sure is getting ahead of herself.)

(Making promises for next year already...
Pinon-chan sure is getting ahead of herself.)
